name: KICKTALE
tagline: Satu hidup. Satu bola. Seribu kemungkinan.
description: An Indonesian football career comic. Create a player, make twenty consequential decisions across five life chapters, and discover a personal legacy. Original articulated SVG characters, seeded seasons, fictional clubs, eight endings and a locally generated collectible career card.

gallery.alt: KICKTALE opening screen with bold sports typography and an original illustrated footballer.

creation.notes: Entirely client-side. Original code-drawn artwork and synthesized sound. No backend or accounts. Proposed websiteUrl should be confirmed before adding to the archive.
